title: Orbit Board v1.0.0 (Orbit Theme & Long-Press Fix)
changelog: Added Orbit Theme: Signature retro Bauhaus Nothing theme with Pitch AMOLED Black background, authentic Dotted Ndot font, and colorful per-key color blocking (Yellow, Blue, Red, White, Charcoal Dark)
Fixed Long-Press Numbers & Symbols: Fixed digit swallowing in Bengali Avro parser and ensured reliable commitText input across all apps
Direct Bengali Composition: Zero English Flash during typing with instant Bengali output and multi-candidate word suggestion strip
Hardware KeyEvent elimination: All long-press symbols and digits now use direct InputConnection commitText for 100% compatibility across all Android apps
